recommendations.title: Address severe tick lag
recommendations.detail: Profiler ran while the server was struggling. Fix sim distance, entity pressure, and heavy mods.
actions: Lower simulation distance and view distance if MSPT is high
Profile while lag is active (30–60s sample)
Pause world pregen during peak player hours

recommendations.title: Clear excess XP orbs
recommendations.detail: 633 experience orbs were present — common farm leak.
actions: Fix mob farm XP collection (hopper, vacuum, etc.)

recommendations.title: Review Create contraptions
recommendations.detail: create:super_glue count was high during capture.
actions: Inspect active Create contraptions and super glue blocks
Reduce loaded chunk count for heavy Create builds

recommendations.title: Consider player-driven lag
recommendations.detail: 6 players were online — chunk loading and player entities add cost.
actions: Check per-player loaded chunks and bases
Spread large builds across dimensions if possible

recommendations.title: Refresh this report
recommendations.detail: Capture a new profile while lagging, then run a Watchtower report.
actions: Run report from dashboard or /watchtower run

Replace deprecated Item.of() patterns per KubeJS 7 migration guide.

crash_summaries.plain_english: World or chunk NBT data looks corrupt (ZLIB/EOF while loading). Restore the affected region from a backup.
fix_hints: Back up the world, then restore the affected region/chunk from a known-good backup.
Only delete or repair the bad region file after the backup exists.
Check disk health; ZLIB/EOF errors often mean incomplete writes.

crash_summaries.plain_english: LuckPerms needs Java 21 but the server runs Java 17 — upgrade the JVM or use an older build.
fix_hints: Upgrade the server JVM to Java 21+ (NeoForge 1.21 expects it). This mod was compiled for Java 21 but the server runs Java 17.
Owning jar: LuckPerms-NeoForge-5.4.jar (luckperms)

mod_fix.action_detail: Run the server on Java 21, or install a LuckPerms build for Java 17

crash_summaries.plain_english: A file is locked by another Windows process — close other Minecraft/Java instances and retry.
fix_hints: Stop other Java/Minecraft instances (and close Explorer previews / antivirus locks) holding: world/session.lock
Only delete world/session.lock after confirming nothing is using this world folder.

crash_summaries.plain_english: Java ran out of heap memory during play.
fix_hints: Confirm the pack needs more heap before raising RAM — oversized packs and leaks look the same.
Increase Java heap (-Xmx) only if the host still has free RAM; otherwise find leaks or shrink the pack.
Check duplicate mods, oversized chunk loaders, or run Spark heap analysis.
